checks.text: With no input, the page shows the heading "Dice Roller", the text "Enter a dice expression", and the result area shows "No rolls yet".

Typing "2d6+3" in the field labelled "Expression" and clicking the button "Roll" shows the text "Total: 12" in the result summary, and the breakdown table contains a row with the label "2d6" and a value that is an integer between 2 and 12.

Typing "1d20" in the field labelled "Expression" and clicking the button "Roll" shows the text "Total: 15" in the result summary when the seed is set to 42, and the breakdown table contains a row with the label "1d20" and the value "15".

Typing "3d6" in the field labelled "Expression" and clicking the button "Roll" shows the text "Total: 10" in the result summary when the seed is set to 7, and the breakdown table contains three rows each with the label "d6" and values "3", "4", and "3" respectively.

Typing "2d6+3" in the field labelled "Expression", clicking "Roll", then typing "1d10" in the field labelled "Expression" and clicking "Roll" again shows the text "Total: 7" in the result summary when the seed is set to 42, and the breakdown table contains only a row with the label "1d10" and the value "7".
Typing "abc" in the field labelled "Expression" and clicking the button "Roll" shows the message "Invalid expression: unknown token 'abc'" and the result summary still shows "No rolls yet".

Typing "2d6+3" in the field labelled "Expression", clicking "Roll", then reloading the page still shows the text "Total: 12" in the result summary and the breakdown table contains a row with the label "2d6".

Typing "1d6" in the field labelled "Expression", checking the checkbox labelled "Crypto", and clicking the button "Roll" shows the text "Total: 4" in the result summary when the crypto seed is set to 99, and the breakdown table contains a row with the label "1d6" and the value "4".
